details: Package @zannstore/baileys@2.4.2 scanned across 433 files with no a static rule matches and no traced code paths indicating installer-side attacker benefit. No hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, credential-harvesting logic, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay of caller data to author-controlled destinations, backdoors, or self-propagation mechanics were observed in the shipped contents. The package name resembles the well-known WhatsApp Web library baileys, but name resemblance alone is not a threat and the current artifact does not exhibit installer-attack behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
